DML.SELECT: SELECT command_element_type_id as "commandElementTypeId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", command_element_id as "id", element_id as "elementId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.command_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.command_elements (command_element_type_id, element_type_id, command_element_id, element_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:commandElementTypeId, :elementTypeId, :id=getNextId{'conf.command_elements'$'command_element_id'$'command_element_type_id=commandElementTypeId;element_type_id=elementTypeId'}, :elementId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.command_elements SET element_id = :elementId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE command_element_type_id = :commandElementTypeId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND command_element_id = :id
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.command_elements WHERE command_element_type_id = :commandElementTypeId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND command_element_id = :id
